readmeExcerpt: The Spring Vault Oracle App sample demonstrates dynamically loading secrets from [OCI Vault](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/KeyManagement/home.htm) into the Spring Boot context during startup. All secrets loaded this way are made available by name as application properties, accessible using `@Value` annotations.
highlights: Access to an OCI Account. You can use [Free Tier](https://signup.oraclecloud.com/).
metaTitle: spring-vault-oracle-app | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Spring Boot sample that loads OCI Vault secrets into the application context.
